property_summary: After any successful transferFrom of a minted position token to a nonzero recipient, the original owner must no longer be able to transferFrom that token (reverting), since ownership moved; the mutant never updates _ownerOf, so the original owner can transfer it again.
change_summary: Remove the state update `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so transferFrom no longer changes the token owner.
